name: HEC Need Based Scholarship Programme 2026-27
eligible_institutions: All HEC-recognized public sector universities in Pakistan including UoP, UET Peshawar, BKUC, KMU, AUP, AWKUM
merit_criteria: Enrolled in regular program with satisfactory academic progress
need_criteria: Financially disadvantaged students from rural and underprivileged backgrounds
other_conditions: Full-time enrolled student in partner public sector universities
award_amount: Full tuition fee coverage plus PKR 6,000 monthly living allowance
benefits: 100% tuition fee waiver, monthly stipend, book allowance
application_procedure: Apply online via HEC portal and submit verified hardcopy to University SFAO
required_documents: Salary slip or income certificate, CNIC of applicant and father, electricity bills (last 6 months), educational transcripts
attestation_requirements: Income certificate attested by relevant Revenue Authority / Tehsildar
evidence_quote: HEC Need Based Scholarships provide complete tuition and monthly stipends for deserving undergraduate students in public universities across Pakistan including Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

name: Bacha Khan University Charsadda Deserving Student Support Fund
domicile_requirements: Charsadda district domicile preferred; open to all KP domicile students
merit_criteria: Minimum 2.50 CGPA or 50% marks in previous examination
need_criteria: Low family income with priority to orphans and daily-wage dependents
other_conditions: Must not be receiving any other government or private scholarship simultaneously
award_amount: Up to 100% tuition fee waiver plus PKR 3,000 monthly stipend
duration: One academic semester, renewable based on academic standing
application_procedure: Submit prescribed financial aid form to Students Financial Aid Office (SFAO) BKUC
required_documents: CNIC/B-Form copy, Father's death/salary certificate, last semester transcript, utility bill copies
attestation_requirements: Attested by Gazetted Officer or Village Council Chairman
contact_address: Students Financial Aid Office, Bacha Khan University Charsadda, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
evidence_quote: Applications are invited from deserving students of BKUC for Need-cum-Merit Financial Aid. Special consideration for Charsadda district domicile holders.

name: University of Peshawar Need-Based & Fee Waiver Aid 2026-27
sponsor: University of Peshawar Students Financial Aid Office
domicile_requirements: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa domicile holders (including Peshawar Division & Charsadda)
need_criteria: Demonstrated financial hardship certified by income documents
benefits: Tuition fee waiver and examination fee support
application_procedure: Submit completed SFAO form with supporting documents to Departmental Financial Aid Committee
required_documents: Salary slip or Tehsildar income certificate, utility bills, CNIC/B-Form
attestation_requirements: Income certificate attested by Tehsildar or Class-I Gazetted Officer
contact_address: Students Financial Aid Office, University of Peshawar, Peshawar
evidence_quote: University of Peshawar SFAO announces Need-Based fee concessions for deserving students of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa enrolled in regular undergraduate and postgraduate programs.

name: UET Peshawar Directorate of Financial Aid Need-cum-Merit Scholarship
sponsor: University of Engineering and Technology Peshawar
district_requirements: All KP settled districts including Charsadda

contact_address: Directorate of Financial Aid, UET Peshawar
evidence_quote: UET Peshawar invites applications from undergraduate engineering students belonging to KP for institutional Need-cum-Merit scholarships.

degree_levels: BBA, BS Computer Science, BS Economics, MBA, MS

domicile_requirements: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa domicile preferred; open to all Pakistani nationals
need_criteria: Financially constrained background verified through Grants & Financial Aid Committee
other_conditions: IMSciences is an autonomous public degree-awarding institution created by KP Govt

evidence_quote: IMSciences Grants Office provides substantial financial assistance and fee concessions to needy and talented students from Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

name: KPEF Chief Minister Higher Education Scholarship Scheme 2026
eligible_institutions: All HEC-recognized public and private universities in KP and top national institutions
fields_of_study: Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, Management, Social Sciences
district_requirements: All KP districts (special quota for backward & rural districts including Charsadda)
merit_criteria: Minimum 65% marks in Intermediate or 3.00 CGPA
need_criteria: Deserving students with verified household income status
age_limit: 28 years for BS, 32 years for MS/MPhil
other_conditions: Must maintain minimum 3.00 CGPA for subsequent renewal
award_amount: Full tuition fee and PKR 5,000 monthly stipend
benefits: Tuition fees paid directly to university and stipend
application_procedure: Apply online through KP Scholarship Portal (scholarships.kpitb.online) or KPEF website
required_documents: KP Domicile certificate, CNIC/B-Form, academic transcripts, parent income certificate
attestation_requirements: Documents must be attested by a Gazetted Officer (BPS-17 or above)
evidence_quote: KPEF invites applications from KP domicile holders for undergraduate and graduate scholarships tenable at recognized universities.

attestation_requirements: Income affidavit on PKR 100 stamp paper
evidence_quote: Ihsan Trust provides purely interest-free student loans (Qarz-e-Hasna) for needy students across all partner public and private universities in Pakistan.

other_conditions: Minimum two years (2,800 hours) of work experience and commitment to return to Pakistan for at least two years
award_amount: Fully funded: University tuition fees, monthly living stipend, return economy flights, arrival allowance

required_documents: Passport, academic transcripts, two reference letters, leadership and career essays
evidence_quote: Chevening Scholarships enable outstanding emerging leaders from Pakistan, including Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, to pursue one-year master's degrees in the UK on full funding.

name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program (USEFP Pakistan) 2027
sponsor: United States Educational Foundation in Pakistan (USEFP)
eligible_institutions: Accredited Universities in the United States
academic_years: Graduates with 16 years (Master's) or 18 years (PhD) education
domicile_requirements: Pakistani citizens residing and working in Pakistan
district_requirements: All Pakistan (active encouragement for KP and rural applicants)

other_conditions: Must return to Pakistan immediately upon completion of degree to serve for period equal to study duration

benefits: Complete funding covering all educational and living expenses in the US
application_procedure: Online application via USEFP portal with GRE and reference letters
required_documents: Academic transcripts with grading scale, 3 reference letters, statement of purpose, personal statement, GRE score report
attestation_requirements: HEC attested transcripts required after initial selection
evidence_quote: USEFP announces Fulbright Degree Program for Pakistani students to pursue Master's or PhD in the US, with strong encouragement for KP applicants.
